theme_and_archetype.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with High-Contrast Swiss
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A healthcare application demands high trust, clarity, and cleanliness (Light theme). The exact user instructions require a dominant RED brand color palette against a clean white background, necessitating a high-contrast layout emphasizing legibility, minimal card-based layouts, and rounded corners.

screens.Splash: Full-screen primary red background (#DC143C) with a white HamroDoctor logo centered. Smooth fade-out transition.
screens.Onboarding: 3 slides. Illustration/image occupying top 60%. Bottom 40% white card (rounded-t-3xl) containing a prominent title (h2), subtitle (body), dot pagination indicator (active dot red), and a primary 'Next'/'Get Started' button.
screens.Language_Select: Clean white screen. H2 title 'Choose Language'. Grid of language cards (English, Nepali, Hindi, Maithili) with radio selectors. Primary 'Continue' button pinned to bottom.
screens.Login_Signup: Minimalist header with back button. H2 'Welcome Back'. Phone number input with country code dropdown. Primary CTA 'Send OTP'. 'Continue with Google/Facebook' social buttons below.
screens.OTP_Verify: H2 'Verify Phone'. 'Code sent to +977 XXXX'. 4 or 6 OTP input boxes row. 'Verify' primary button. 'Resend in 0:30' ghost text.
screens.Patient_Dashboard: Top nav: User avatar, greeting 'Hello, Ram', Notification bell. Section 1: Search bar (Find doctors, clinics). Section 2: Quick actions grid (Book Appointment, Lab Test, Medicines, Emergency). Section 3: Upcoming Appointment card (Horizontal layout, doctor avatar, date, time, 'View Ticket' button). Section 4: Health Summary cards.
screens.Doctor_Discovery: Sticky top header with search input. Scrollable horizontal row of filter chips (Specialty, Gender, Fees, Rating). Vertical scroll list of Doctor Cards (Avatar left, Name/Specialty/Rating/Fees right, 'Book Now' secondary button).
screens.Doctor_Profile: Top section: Doctor image, Name, Specialty, Experience, Rating. Middle section: Tab navigation (Info, Reviews). Bottom section: Horizontal scroll date selector, Grid of time slots (green = available, gray = booked). Fixed bottom bar with 'Book Appointment' button.
screens.Appointment_Booking: Multi-step accordion/flow. Step 1: Confirm details. Step 2: Patient selection (Self/Family member). Step 3: Payment method (Mocked eSewa, Khalti, Card icons in a grid). Fixed bottom 'Pay & Confirm' button.
screens.Digital_Ticket: Modal or distinct screen. White ticket card with dashed border line in middle. Top half: Token # (massive text, e.g., '12'), 'Current Serving: 8', Est. Wait Time. Bottom half: Patient name, Doctor name, Clinic address, Date/Time. QR code at the bottom.
screens.E_Prescription: Header 'Prescription'. Card with Doctor details top. Diagnosis section. 'Medicines' list (Medicine name, dosage pattern e.g., 1-0-1, duration). Floating Action Button or bottom CTA to 'Order Medicines' or 'Download PDF'.
screens.Health_Records: Timeline layout. Vertical dashed line on the left. Timeline items (dot on line, card on right). Filter by (Prescriptions, Lab Reports, X-Rays). Card contains document icon, title, date, doctor name.
screens.Emergency: High-contrast dark or white screen with massive red buttons. Main action: 'Call Ambulance' (Red gradient button). Grid of nearby hospitals with distances. One-tap actions for Blood Bank, Police.
screens.Symptom_Checker: Chat interface. AI avatar on left (gray bubbles), User on right (red tinted bubbles). Suggested quick-reply chips at the bottom above the input field.
screens.Pharmacy: Search bar for medicines. 'Upload Prescription' banner card (primary red background with illustration). List of ordered medicines with status trackers.
screens.Profile_Settings: Avatar and name top. List view of settings items (My Family, Saved Doctors, Payment Methods, Language, Help & Support, Logout) with left icon and right chevron.

doctor_avatar_1.description: Male doctor with glasses, suitable for doctor profiles

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='login-button', data-testid='doctor-card-1', data-testid='digital-ticket-token-number', data-testid='bottom-tab-home'.

motion_and_interaction.page_transition: Slide in from right for new screens, slide out to right for back navigation (Standard mobile pattern).
motion_and_interaction.button_press: Scale down to 0.98 on active/press state.
motion_and_interaction.modal_bottom_sheet: Slide up from bottom with a backdrop-blur overlay. Used for Language Selection, Filter menus, and Payment confirmation.
motion_and_interaction.skeleton_loading: Use pulse animation (bg-slate-200 animate-pulse) for loading states (Doctor list, Lab results) instead of spinners.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: Use React JS, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (where applicable), but restrict the max width (max-w-md mx-auto) to simulate a mobile app interface. Wrap the main layout in a mobile container.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react icons heavily. They match the requested clean, minimal aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_library: Prefer custom raw HTML/Tailwind for cards and specific layouts over generic Shadcn components when Shadcn feels too 'dashboard-like', since this is a mobile super app.
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Implement a sticky Bottom Tab bar as the primary global navigation, hiding it only on auth/onboarding/payment screens.
instructions_to_main_agent.dark_mode: MVP is strictly Light Mode based on wireframe requirements. Do not apply inverse dark mode colors to surfaces.
